title: Dehumidifier Impact on Mould Risk
dataSources: Mould risk (`mould:risk`), crack meters (`crackmeter:reading`), HVAC filter life (`hvacfilter:life`), structural tilt (`structural:tilt`).
app: Building-health sensors — indoor humidity / mould-risk monitors, crack and tilt meters, HVAC filter-life trackers, and damp sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and ESPHome.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mould:risk dehumidifier_state=*
| stats avg(humidity_pct) as avg_humidity, avg(dewpoint_gap) as avg_gap by room dehumidifier_state
| sort room dehumidifier_state
description: Compares room humidity and condensation margin with the dehumidifier on versus off.
value: This turns a dehumidifier from a vague comfort device into something you can verify is doing useful work.
implementation: Send room readings with dehumidifier state to `index=personal`; compare averages for on and off periods.
visualization: Grouped room table of humidity and dew-point gap by dehumidifier state.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether the dehumidifier is really making a measurable difference in the rooms you worry about.
